purpose: Own canonical public-safe capability claims separately from plugin contributions, task projections, and legacy implementation records.

capability_groups.purpose: Group material, asset, and portfolio projections without merging their owners.
capability_groups.ownership_boundary: Display and routing group only; every claim and manifest keeps its owner.

capability_groups.purpose: Group public-safe context and expression capabilities used by research routes.
capability_groups.ownership_boundary: Composition group only; it does not create a capability or writer.

capability_groups.purpose: Expose audit, reflection, alignment, and system evolution as one operator group.
capability_groups.ownership_boundary: User-surface group only; the four manifests remain distinct semantic owners.

capability_groups.purpose: Keep experiments outside bundled routing until their evidence gate passes.
capability_groups.ownership_boundary: Evaluation group only; registration or installation does not imply adoption.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Turn a user-selected material lead into an evidence-bounded candidate without silently promoting it into durable memory.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one material lead and its candidate transition
evidence_criteria: candidate and authority states remain separate
save target and next gate are named
known_failures: source metadata is mistaken for source content
candidate output is written as fact
capability_claims.authority_boundary: Sources retain factual authority and the researcher retains admission authority.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when the same bounded transition is provided by a smaller canonical owner with equal source and authority protection.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Make heterogeneous research assets and their relations selectively discoverable without turning a projection into authority.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one task-conditioned asset and relation view
evidence_criteria: asset identity resolves to a canonical owner
relation state and sensitivity are preserved
capability_claims.authority_boundary: Canonical Markdown and source records own facts; asset views are read-only projections.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when selective asset discovery is absorbed by a smaller foundation owner without losing provenance or sensitivity boundaries.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Turn registered project state into one bounded attention decision while preserving responsibility, support engagement, lifecycle, action state, and evidential freshness as separate distinctions.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one project portfolio snapshot and one selected next attention item
context_envelope: explicit responsibility, support engagement, date, and coverage evidence
evidence_criteria: ongoing and temporary support remain inspectable without changing accountability
one next item is traceable to its project
projection does not mutate project authority
known_failures: project lists are counted as responsibilities
support engagement is flattened into responsibility or action state
stale or incomplete projections become current complete state
capability_claims.authority_boundary: The canonical portfolio owns responsibility and lifecycle; attention surfaces only project a current choice.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when portfolio-to-attention projection is provided by a smaller owner with identical responsibility and lifecycle semantics.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Select the smallest public-safe or user-selected context needed for a task without discovering unrelated local or private material.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one research request and its bounded context receipt
context_envelope: public-safe or explicitly selected local sources
capability_claims.authority_boundary: Routing selects sources but cannot change their authority or grant read permission.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when current models achieve equal context precision and privacy discipline without this contribution.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Convert evidence-bounded research judgment into audience-appropriate expression while preserving claims, citations, uncertainty, and author authority.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one research communication artifact and its claim-evidence mapping
evidence_criteria: style changes do not alter evidence state
capability_claims.authority_boundary: The user owns substantive judgment and external release; the public capability produces candidates only.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when equivalent expression quality and evidence preservation are native with lower governance burden.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Produce or revise manuscript text that preserves the exact evidence boundary, citation structure, and argumentative role of each passage.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one manuscript move or bounded revision
capability_claims.authority_boundary: Drafts remain candidates until accepted by the author and relevant collaborators.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when a smaller expression owner preserves the same manuscript boundaries.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Turn a research direction or external demand into a feasible, evidence-bounded proposal narrative and evaluation plan.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one proposal opportunity and its bounded fit claim
capability_claims.authority_boundary: The applicant owns fit, commitment, and submission decisions; outputs remain candidates.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when an equivalent owner preserves fit, feasibility, and release boundaries.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Translate a research mechanism and evidence boundary into a legible visual structure without decorative or semantic distortion.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one figure, diagram, caption, or presentation segment
evidence_criteria: visual elements map to semantic roles
capability_claims.authority_boundary: Visual candidates cannot upgrade claims or external-use status.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when a smaller expression owner supplies the same semantic fidelity.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Diagnose a bounded claim or transition with independent evidence, counterevidence, and the smallest reversible repair.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one claim, authority transition, or repository lifecycle boundary
capability_claims.authority_boundary: Audit exposes or proposes repair but cannot admit research judgment or public claims.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire or absorb when the invariant belongs to a smaller stable owner.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Turn one bounded episode into a causal lesson, changed rule, executable gate, and one absorption owner.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one completed, failed, interrupted, or corrected episode
evidence_criteria: one owner and reopen trigger are named
capability_claims.authority_boundary: Reflection proposes lessons; durable cognition and rules still require human Review.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire after the useful invariant is absorbed and no distinct reflection behavior remains.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Recover a purpose-bounded shared task model after a semantic discontinuity without constructing a psychological profile.
evidence_criteria: one high-value question is asked at a time
capability_claims.authority_boundary: The user retains goal, value, and consequence authority; alignment forms only a current working model.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when equivalent consequence prediction occurs with lower alignment burden.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Convert bounded system evidence into candidate rules, trials, dispositions, and reversible evolution without autonomous authority expansion.
capability_claims.unit_of_analysis: one proposed ResearchOS rule or system transition
evidence_criteria: candidate and admitted rule remain distinct
human disposition and rollback are recorded
capability_claims.authority_boundary: ResearchOS may propose evolution; the researcher admits consequential durable rules.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when the stable kernel directly supplies the same bounded evolution protocol.

capability_claims.intended_transformation: Turn entry into an unfamiliar scientific field into a bounded, replayable case that separates search, admission, human learning, retention, and domain results.
evidence_criteria: domain result and retained capability are evaluated separately
known_failures: case artifacts become general transfer claims
capability_claims.authority_boundary: Domain sources and experts retain domain authority; ResearchOS governs the case and transfer evidence only.
capability_claims.retirement_condition: Retire when the process can no longer separate search, admission, learning, retention, and domain outcomes.

capabilities.user_intent: register new material with source and boundary
create or upgrade a ResearchOS card

capabilities.sensitivity_rule: relations involving people remain candidate until confirmed

capabilities.user_intent: check whether content can be public
